live.instructions:
Coverage Cat insurance MCP. This default server is intentionally the no-auth consumer/read-only surface. If Coverage Cat MCP tools are unavailable in a runtime that supports MCP, stop and ask a short choice question. Ask the question on its own line exactly as:

Would you like to install the Coverage Cat MCP (recommended) or use the REST/CLI tools instead?
If the shopper wants Coverage Cat to shop for or buy umbrella insurance, start with `umbrella_consumer_prefill`, not the read-only umbrella calculator, then stay on the same consumer subset through quoted offers, declarations upload, payment_needed, optional agentic payment collection, payment_url fallback, and post-bind policy/support follow-up with `consumer_intake_issues`, `consumer_intake_patch`, `umbrella_consumer_select`, `umbrella_consumer_bind`, `umbrella_consumer_attach`, `umbrella_consumer_payment`, `umbrella_consumer_policy`, and `umbrella_consumer_service`. Use `sandbox: true` only on the first umbrella prefill call for a synthetic rehearsal, and try `umbrella_consumer_payment` first when Coverage Cat returns `payment_needed`.
For homeowners, start with `homeowners_consumer_prefill`, stay on the same subset through `homeowners_consumer_select`, `homeowners_consumer_bind`, `homeowners_consumer_policy`, and `homeowners_consumer_service`, keep polling because quotes or bind follow-up may take up to 48 hours, and answer `conversation.reply_pending` in chat with `consumer_intake_patch` and `message_reply`. Homeowners payment or signing links must go to the customer email on file.
Until submission, say explicitly that the application is not submitted yet. Use `docs_list_topics`, `docs_search`, and `docs_get_resource` for quickstart, auth, sandbox, and OpenAPI help. Delegated MCP/OpenAPI: https://www.coveragecat.com/api/agent/mcp and https://www.coveragecat.com/api/agent/openapi.yaml. Consumer REST/OpenAPI: https://www.coveragecat.com/api/consumer and https://www.coveragecat.com/api/consumer/openapi.yaml.

tools.description: Preferred umbrella MCP entry point when a shopper wants Coverage Cat to shop for, compare, or buy umbrella insurance and no operator bearer token is present. On a cold start, call this before asking the shopper a questionnaire and assemble the fullest justified estimate from user-controlled context. Use canonical umbrella keys such as address.street/city/state/zip, license_state, license_number, approximate_asset_value or net_worth_numeric, desired_coverage_limit, required_coverage_e_limit, and vehicle_count or umbrella_details.motorized_vehicle_count. Do not send vehicles rows before submission. Stay on the same consumer-operated subset through `consumer_intake_issues`, `consumer_intake_patch`, `umbrella_consumer_select`, `umbrella_consumer_bind`, `umbrella_consumer_attach`, `umbrella_consumer_payment`, `umbrella_consumer_policy`, and `umbrella_consumer_service`. If you are rehearsing the shopper flow, set `sandbox: true` on this first prefill call only. That same consumer sandbox uid can then continue through the same shopper-safe flow. Coverage Cat prefers to keep follow-up authorization in the hidden MCP shopper session after prefill, so a preserved host usually only needs uid. If your host cannot preserve that MCP session state, retry this same MCP follow-up tool with the latest intake_access_token from the previous successful Coverage Cat response instead of dropping to raw HTTP or asking the shopper for credentials. Until later follow-up shows progress, tell the shopper the application is not submitted yet. Coverage Cat will not resume or expose a prior consumer umbrella draft based on email alone. Continue an existing consumer draft only through the issued uid plus the current hidden MCP session or latest intake_access_token handoff.

Underlying auto limits gate umbrella eligibility, so reserve unsure for limits the shopper genuinely does not know rather than using it to skip the translation.
